Title: Caspian Courtyard Hotel
Description: Stone-walled rooms around a quiet courtyard inside the UNESCO-listed Old City, a short walk from the Maiden Tower.

Title: Fountain Square Suites
Description: Modern suites on the pedestrian heart of Baku, surrounded by cafés, shops and Nizami Street.

Title: Boulevard Bay Hotel
Description: Sea-view rooms on the Caspian waterfront promenade, steps from the Boulevard park and the Carpet Museum.

Title: Flame View Residence
Description: Upper-floor apartments near Highland Park with views of the city and the illuminated Flame Towers.

Title: Port Baku Lofts
Description: Loft-style rooms in the Port Baku district, close to the seafront, shopping and the metro.
